sources.name: BusElche / Avanza official route pages for radial Lines R1, R2 and R3
Current AliBus ordered R1, R2 and R3 stop pages with municipal stop codes and map coordinates
Accepted non-radial Elche merged scenario used for exact urban StopNode and StopPlace reuse

transformations.description: Combines each current Ida and Vuelta stop list into one complete vehicle cycle. Repeated handoff and initial cycle boundary occurrences are removed, and closesLoop=true adds the final edge once.
Uses municipal stop code as the stable elche-stop and elche-place suffix. Existing codes are copied exactly from elche-legacy-all-v1.
Creates one strict parser-compatible StopPlace for every new radial StopNode. No proximity-only physical merges are made.
Writes established scenario assets, computes asset SHA-256 values and aggregate contentHash, and registers the scenario.

warnings: Runtime StopNode sourceReferences remain empty for new radial nodes because that field accepts only genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position components. Municipal codes and AliBus coordinate links remain build provenance.
Accepted urban StopNode and StopPlace objects reused from elche-legacy-all-v1 retain their exact previous bytes and coordinates.
R1 revisits elche-stop-080 (Renfe-Conservatorio) twice during one complete cycle. Both non-consecutive occurrences are retained.
R3 uses one municipal ITV stop, elche-stop-281, as the directional handoff. The source repeats it at the Ida/Vuelta boundary; the canonical cycle stores it once.
Camino De Los Magros 1 / 3 and Camino De Los Magros 2 / Camino Servicio Autovia 2 are extremely close but have different municipal codes. They remain distinct StopNodes and StopPlaces.
Physical StopPlace creation does not create route edges, reverse patterns, or cross-pattern itinerary edges.
